en.name: Shoulder circles
en.subtitle: Teacher-marked movement · Primary 1–3
steps: Stand comfortably with your arms relaxed and your head facing ahead.
Move both shoulders a little forwards.
Move them back and down to finish a small circle.
Reverse the direction: back, up, forwards, then down. Follow your teacher’s count.
Let the shoulders relax. Keep your head comfortable rather than circling your neck.
en.focus: Teacher marks each complete circle and notes the direction; the camera does not score shoulder rotation.

zh-Hant.name: 肩膀繞圈
zh-Hant.subtitle: 老師記錄動作 · 小一至小三
steps: 舒適站立，雙臂放鬆，頭部朝前。
雙肩向後再向下，完成一個小圈。
反方向再做：向後、向上、向前、向下，次數跟隨老師。
放鬆雙肩，頭部保持舒適，不用轉動頸部畫圈。
zh-Hant.focus: 老師記錄每個完整肩圈及方向；鏡頭不會自動評估肩膀轉動。
